thread:
noah: Starting rollout v2.9.1-slim. Plan: EU micro-canary 3% -> US staged (10% -> 25%) -> APAC warm then open. Change window 01:00-05:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1.5% for 3m OR p95 >1250ms. Pin encoder to 4.0.1-compat. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.9.1

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU micro-canary start: service=frontend variant=v2.9.1-slim region=eu slices=1/30 ts=3999000020

ivy: EU capacity check: 7 spare GPUs, warm-pool 28% primed. I'll mute nightly batch jobs at +8m.

ops-oncall: Dashboards live. Alerts: 5xx >=1.5% -> #ops-alerts, p95 >=1250ms -> #ops-alerts. Adding transient alert for KV miss >10%.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU health @6m: p95=390ms, 5xx=0.2% Status=GREEN

noah: Proceed to US slice 1 (10%). Keep 10m holds. APAC warm at 20% until US+EU stable for 1h.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 start: region=us slices=1/10 ts=3999000045

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 @4m: p95=580ms, 5xx=0.9% OK

sam: Spinning US warm-pool for slice 2; prefill caches. Note: worker.timeout default=30s.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 start: slices=2/10 ts=3999000058

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 @3m: 5xx=1.7% -> ALERT to #ops-alerts

ops-oncall: Pausing ramp. Triage shows 502s from async-worker queue depth spike. Ivy, try increasing worker.timeout to 60s and enable cache-prefill.

ivy: Applying overrides: worker.timeout=60s, cache.prefill=true ts=3999000062

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @2m: 5xx dropped to 0.5%, p95=610ms. Alert cleared. Hold slice 2 for 20m before ramp. No rollback.

noah: Adding note to release notes about encoder pin and the mitigation applied. Continue staggered ramp after holds; APAC opens only after 1h stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
